## Notes

Paradox Development Studio, Paradox Interactive, 2016-06-06; Windows, macOS, Linux. Start dates 1936-01-01 and 1939-08-14. National focus trees (initially unique for Germany, UK, USSR, US); civilian and military factories and dockyards; political power for laws and ministers; four ideologies; supply affects combat; weather in sea and air regions; world tension 0 to 100; tank, ship, and plane designers added by DLC.
